{{Quote|When I remember the Horned Axe, I recall the scent of hawthorn. I recall a purple evening sky shot with red gold. I recall that her edges dripped where she had lately been at work.|The Colours of the Double Threshold}}

'''The Horned-Axe''' is one of the [[Hours]], associated with hour XIII, or 1:00pm. Her [[Aspects]] are {{Lore|Knock}}, {{Lore|Winter}}, and {{Lore|Edge}}. As the last surviving God-from-Stone, she heralds from those Hours who came into being before humanity; the others tragically perished in [[the Lithomachy]]. Intricately tied to boundaries and transitions, The Horned-Axe "watches all thresholds", wielding her sharp and divisive nature in vigilant opposition against the all-consuming tendencies of [[The Crowned Growth]]. This natural disposition to cleave and separate places her in stark enmity with [[The Twins]], whose very essence is to unify.

==Notes==
*The Horned-Axe, with her intrinsic link to boundaries, draws inspiration from the Roman minor goddess [[wikipedia:Cardea|Cardea]], the deity presiding over door hinges. The emblematic hawthorn associated with Cardea—a gift before her unfortunate encounter with [[wikipedia:Janus|Janus]]—also finds resonance with The Horned-Axe.
